title: Maximum elastic potential energy
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum elastic potential energy as 0.6*m*v0^2 using conservation of energy and momentum.

title: Maximum spring compression
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum compression of the spring as 0.768*v0*t0 using relative displacement analysis.

title: Friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly determines the kinetic friction coefficient as 0.45 using work-energy theorem on the incline.

title: Conservation of momentum application
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to find the common velocity at maximum compression or the post-collision velocities.

title: Work-energy on incline
description: Important: Sets up correct work-energy equations for the block's ascent and descent on the rough incline.

title: Mass ratio determination
description: Important: Correctly deduces the mass ratio (m_B = 5m) from the v-t graph and given displacement.

title: Relative displacement analysis
description: Optional: Correctly analyzes the displacements of A and B from t=0 to t0 to find the compression.

title: Sign error in velocities
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for velocities on the v-t graph or in momentum equations.

title: Energy conservation mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies energy conservation by omitting the spring's potential energy or kinetic energy terms.

title: Unit or symbolic error
description: Pitfall: Presents final answers with incorrect units or inconsistent symbolic expressions.
